info.title: billparse
info.description:
HTTP API: upload a file, get the parsed document; read and manage the layout specs and the learning jobs.

    uvicorn billparse.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000        (the API page: GET /parse)
    curl -F file=@invoice.pdf localhost:8000/parse

The paths and response models are invoice-parser's (invoiceparse/api.py and webapi.py), so its web app and clients
work unchanged. The store comes from the environment (DATABASE_URL, PARSER_DATA_DIR), as for the CLI. Parsing runs
billparse's pipeline: built-in specs, learned specs, the rule mapper, then (with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) the LLM routes.
With AGENT_ENABLED=1, a file that no spec proves gets one from the agent during its upload (agent.py), and is read
with it; /learn/jobs lists every learning run. Learning costs money: it is off unless AGENT_ENABLED=1.

post.description: Admit the signed-in person with an invite code (once: later sign-ins need no code).
Start parsing a file and return at once; GET /parse/tasks/{sha256} says how it goes.

schema.title: Response Parse Tasks Parse Tasks Get

post.description:
Parse the stored file again and run the agent for it again (a new spec, or an improve round on the spec that
reads it), in the background. Paid when learning is on.
Stop the learning or improving run of this file (the parse itself takes seconds and is not stopped).

schema.title: Response Stop Document Documents  Sha256  Stop Post

post.description:
Parse the stored file again with the specs and code of today, in the background: no agent and no model
request, so it is free.

get.description: Everything the result page shows, with every charge (the browser pages and filters them).

delete.description: Delete the result, its runs and the uploaded file. Layout specs and jobs stay.

schema.title: Response Delete Document Documents  Sha256  Delete

get.description: The parsed document in the output contract (the approved version when there is one).

Rows `offset`..`offset+limit` of one table (0-based in the table), each with the role the parser gave it.
Rows past the stored 5,000 of a large table are read from the uploaded file.

schema.title: Response Source Lines Documents  Sha256  Source Lines Get

get.description: A PDF page as an image: every line boxed by what the parser made of it, `focus_line` in yellow.

schema.title: Response Highlight Legend Highlight Legend Get

get.description: Documents waiting for review, most money at risk first.

schema.title: Response Review Queue Review Queue Get

post.description: Apply the edits and check the totals again; nothing is saved.

Approve the document with the edits: it goes to the gold set, its candidate spec is verified when no charge
changed, corrected service codes become synonyms. Every checklist item must be ticked.

schema.title: Response Review Approve Documents  Sha256  Review Approve Post

get.description: Every step of the job: what Claude read, its reasoning summary, each spec it checked and the result.

schema.title: Response Job Trace Events Learn Jobs  Job Id  Trace Get
Response Delete Alias Aliases  Provider   Label Norm  Delete

post.description: Parse one file (CSV, TSV, xlsx, JSON, YAML, Terraform, PDF, pptx, docx, text, zip).

parameters.name: force

schema.description: parse again a file seen before; a learning or improving job of the file that ended without a spec runs again
schema.title: Force

parameters.description: parse again a file seen before; a learning or improving job of the file that ended without a spec runs again

schema.title: Response Get Spec Specs  Spec Id  Get

put.description: Create a spec, or save a new version of it. A spec without a status is saved as a draft.

schema.title: Response Put Spec Specs  Spec Id  Put
Response Spec History Specs  Spec Id  History Get
Response Set Spec Status Specs  Spec Id  Status Patch

post.description: Run the strict verifier: may this spec read this file? (Models off; nothing is saved.)

schema.title: Response Verify Spec Specs Verify Post

post.description:
Ask the agent for a spec for this file; save it as a draft when the code's checks prove it. Calls the Claude
API: allowed only with AGENT_ENABLED=1. A file that a saved spec already reads is refused (409, no model call)
unless `replace` is true. The new spec never overwrites a saved one: an id that exists gets a suffix.

schema.title: Response Learn Spec Specs Learn Post

get.description: Every learning run: one per layout that no spec read (status, spec made, its status, cost).

schema.title: Response Learn Jobs Learn Jobs Get

get.description: One learning run, with the code's report on the spec the agent wrote.

schema.title: Response Learn Job Learn Jobs  Job Id  Get

post.description: Let this layout be sent to Claude again on its next upload (or backfill).

schema.title: Response Learn Retry Learn Jobs  Job Id  Retry Post

post.description:
Stop a running job: it ends at its next step as failed, with what it cost so far, and the file keeps the
result it had before the run.

schema.title: Response Learn Stop Learn Jobs  Job Id  Stop Post

post.description:
Parse again every stored document that no spec proved, so each layout gets a spec. Calls the Claude API
once per new layout: allowed only with AGENT_ENABLED=1.

schema.title: Response Learn Backfill Learn Backfill Post

post.description: Run the nightly loop and answer with its report.

ReviewEdits.title: ReviewEdits
ReviewEdits.description:
A person's changes to one document, sent whole each time (the server keeps no review session):
`rows` edits charges by id (any of description, cost, kind, counted, service, service_code, delete),
`added` are new charges, `dropped_gaps` the indexes of gaps marked resolved (of the stored document).
